Static worksharing over disjoint (z,y) rows keeps x contiguous; each worksharing loop's implicit barrier ensures the next timestep sees completed output. This trades fork/join overhead for six synchronization points and tests one implementation against the serial baseline; it does not establish a comparison with a per-step-team implementation before controller measurement.
